title: Quantum-Enhanced Single-Parameter Phase Estimation with Adaptive NOON States
summary: Quantum metrology promises phase sensitivity surpassing the shot-noise limit by exploiting entanglement and photon-number correlations. NOON states-maximally path-entangled $N$-photon superpositions $(|N,0\rangle + |0,N\rangle)/\sqrt{2}$ -achieve the Heisenberg limit $1/N$ for single-parameter estimation, as demonstrated experimentally by Afek et al. (2010) using hybrid coherent-plus-squeezed light up to $N=5$.
